study type: In vitro experimental study with an animal model
cohort: Neurospheres derived from neural progenitor cells obtained from the whole brains of control and surgically IUGR-induced rabbit pups.
finding: Intrauterine growth restriction (IUGR) significantly increased neurite length, and lactoferrin (LF) or its major compound, sialic acid (SA), prevented this abnormal neurite extension, making them promising therapies.
